name: Looking-Glass Rogue
description:
Duelists who went down the wrong maintenance shaft, came back the wrong size, and never quite came back right. Nothing they do happens the same way twice.

Sentence First lands the blow now and brings the verdict later. Size is a loan: One Side, Other Side takes it from an enemy or hands it over until they're stuck. Your reflection steps out of the glass at the opposite size, enemies drop down a rabbit hole and land hard somewhere else, and the hours of the Tea Clock buy six impossible things. Dodges and kills build Wonder, which tilts every random outcome your way. In the last ranks you learn to vanish, to leave your grin behind, and then to become the Grinning Cat. Favors [AGL] and [PSI].

Example mod: almost every skill runs on conditions, counters and the extra triggers (see LookingGlass/README.md).

effects.name: Wonder
effects.description: Things keep getting curiouser. Every stack sharpens your crits and dodges, and tilts your random outcomes toward the good ones. It fades if nothing strange happens for a while.

effects.name: Tea Clock
effects.description: The hours of the fight. Each turn in combat moves it on, and growing or waiting beside an enemy (once you know Six Impossible Things) moves it faster. At six o'clock it's always tea time: you catch your breath and something whimsical happens.

effects.name: Shrunk
effects.description: A few inches tall. Very hard to hit, but your blows land softer. Much of your kit works differently while you're small.

effects.name: Grown
effects.description: Head scraping the ceiling. You hit much harder and shrug off more, but you're an easy target. Much of your kit works differently while you're big.

effects.name: Painted Red
effects.description: Daubed in red paint. Easier to find, and the Grinning Cat's teeth tear every layer off at once.

effects.name: Topsy-Turvy
effects.description: Up is down and left is a rumour. It hits softer and can't get out of the way.

effects.name: Sentenced
effects.description: The punishment has already happened. The trial comes in a few turns, and the crime comes last of all. If it strikes whoever sentenced it, that was the crime, and it pays on the spot. Otherwise the verdict falls when this runs out.

effects.name: Belittled
effects.description: Its size has been taken back. A few feet shorter, it hits like it.

effects.name: Overgrown
effects.description: Handed more size than the room can hold. One arm is out of a window and one foot is up a chimney: it can't move, and it can't get out of the way of anything.

effects.name: Impossible Things
effects.description: Each thing believed is one that simply happens: the next skill takes no time and leaves no cooldown behind.

effects.name: Reflected
effects.description: A reflection on the wrong side of the glass. Shots bounce off it half the time, it is always the opposite size to you, and when it breaks the shards go into whoever is nearest.

effects.name: Slowly, Tail First
effects.description: Going, a piece at a time. Anything more than a tile away keeps losing sight of you, and when the last of you has gone the grin comes back with teeth.

effects.name: Only a Head
effects.description: There is nothing below the neck to hurt, so nothing can take health from you.

effects.name: Falling
effects.description: Falling, very slowly, past cupboards and bookshelves, and getting smaller all the way. When this runs out it lands somewhere else, hard, and takes every layer of Painted Red off on the floor.

effects.name: Grinning
effects.description: Mostly gone. Only the grin is still there, and it's very hard to hit a grin.

effects.name: Lingering Grin
effects.description: A grin with nobody behind it. Enemies can't stop looking at it, anyone who strikes it is left topsy-turvy, and when it fades it snaps its teeth on the nearest of them.

effects.name: Spare Life
effects.description: Cats keep more than one. The next killing blow finds this one instead and leaves you Grinning.

effects.name: The Grinning Cat
effects.description: You are a gaunt striped cat that comes and goes as it pleases, tail first and grin last, and the grin is always a little too wide. Very hard to pin down, every dodge rakes the one who swung, and a killing blow finds no body to land on (once). You fight with the cat's teeth and tricks until it fades or you Reappear.

kit.name: Grin of Teeth
kit.description: A grin far too big for any face opens around them and snaps shut. It tears off every layer of Painted Red for more, bites deeper into anyone turned around, and leaves them bleeding.

kit.name: No-Name Wood
kit.description: Grow a wood where nothing has a name. At once and each turn after, whatever stands among the trees forgets what it is and whose side it was on, and strikes at whatever is closest. What is too strong to forget is only turned around. Each forgotten name counts as a riddle.

kit.name: Slowly, Tail First
kit.description: Vanish a piece at a time, starting at the tail and ending with the grin. For two turns anything more than a tile away loses track of you and nothing lands easily, and when the last of you has gone the grin comes back with teeth: everything within two tiles is bitten, and bitten harder if it's turned around.

kit.name: May Look at a King
kit.description: A cat may look at a king, and it does. The bigger they are the harder this look lands: against bosses and elites it is a heavy psychic blow that stops them mid-thought and sets their big moves back two turns. On anything lesser it is only rude, and their big moves wait a turn.

kit.name: No Body to Behead
kit.description: You can't cut off a head unless there's a body to cut it off from. Leave only your head in the air until your next turn: nothing can take health from you, and whatever is close is left topsy-turvy, trying to work out what it just aimed at. Each one counts as a riddle.

kit.name: Which Way?
kit.description: Ask them which way they ought to go, then answer for them: you and they warp into each other's places, and they're left topsy-turvy (not bosses). Leaves you Grinning.

kit.name: All Mad Here
kit.description: Point out to everyone nearby that they must be mad, or they wouldn't have come here. A psychic jolt that grows with every riddle asked this fight; they lose their bearings and their big moves wait, and with four Wonder or more they lose their words too and the room rearranges itself around them (each may warp up to two tiles). Each one counts as a riddle.

kit.name: Reappear
kit.description: Come all the way back, grin first this time, with your breath and a little Wonder.

newAbility.name: Curiouser
newAbility.description: Dodging builds Wonder and so does a kill. Every fight starts the Tea Clock at noon and every turn in it moves the clock on. Each third skill you use sets off a little whimsy of its own. Shrinking builds Wonder and growing moves the clock (once a turn each).

newAbility.name: Sentence First
newAbility.description: Sentence first, verdict afterwards. The blow falls now and the reason for it comes later: three turns on, the target is found guilty, found guilty of something else, or quietly pardoned, and Wonder leans on the jury. A sentence already passed can't be passed again. While you know it, anything under sentence that strikes you has committed the crime at last: it pays at once and is painted red. Grown, the blow is heavier. Shrunk, it builds Wonder.

perk.name: Off With Its Head
perk.description: Every sentence is the same sentence, in the end. Wonder helps you find the neck.

newAbility.name: One Side, Other Side
newAbility.description: One side of the mushroom makes you taller and the other makes you shorter, and there is only so much size in a room. Unless you're Grown, you take the target's: you are Grown and it is Belittled, hitting far softer. Grown, you hand it all over: you are Shrunk and it is Overgrown, jammed in place with an arm out of a window and easy to hit. Builds Wonder, and with four or more you get a burst of speed too.

perk.name: Growth Spurt
perk.description: There was room for you a moment ago. There isn't now, and everyone beside you finds out.

newAbility.name: The Looking-Glass
newAbility.description: Breathe on the air until it mists over and let what's on the other side step out: a reflection of you with your gear and your skills, and always the opposite size. Shots bounce off it half the time, and when it breaks the shards fly into the nearest enemies and you get two Wonder. Use it again while the reflection stands to step through the glass: you trade places with it and change size, and so it changes too.

perk.name: Soft as Gauze
perk.description: The glass melts away like a bright silvery mist, and you are through before anyone sees it happen.

newAbility.name: Down the Rabbit Hole
newAbility.description: Open a burrow under them (not bosses). They drop out of the fight and away down it, getting smaller and smaller, with plenty of time to look about them and wonder what's going to happen next. Two turns later they come down somewhere else in the room, hard. All their Painted Red comes off for more with every layer, and anything they land near takes it too.

perk.name: Very Deep Well
perk.description: It doesn't close behind them. Anything that follows gets the same long look at the shelves.

newAbility.name: Six Impossible Things
newAbility.description: It's only a matter of practice, and it has to be done before breakfast. Wind the Tea Clock back to noon and believe one impossible thing for every hour you took off it: each of your next skills, for that many skills, takes no time and leaves no cooldown behind. Belief wears off within two turns. While you know it, waiting with an enemy close moves the Tea Clock on an extra hour.

perk.name: Before Breakfast
perk.description: Sometimes you've believed as many as six before you've sat down.

newAbility.name: Vanishing Grin
newAbility.description: Fade out from the tail up and reappear somewhere else in the room, still grinning: very hard to hit, and your next blows find the soft spots. Builds two Wonder. While you know it, dropping below a third of your health with two enemies on you shrinks you and leaves only the grin (once every twelve turns), and every second step you take while small builds Wonder.

perk.name: Only the Grin
perk.description: Less of you comes back than left, and it is still smiling.

newAbility.name: Grin Without a Cat
newAbility.description: Warp away all at once and leave your grin hanging where you stood. Every enemy near it can't look away and goes for it instead of you, anyone who strikes it is left topsy-turvy, and when it fades or breaks its teeth snap shut on the nearest of them. You land Grinning. Kept at hand as the Grinning Cat.

perk.name: Wider Grin
perk.description: It opens across the room, and everyone close by loses track of which way is up.

newAbility.name: The Grinning Cat
newAbility.description: With four Wonder or more, in a fight: stop being a duelist and become the uncanny striped cat that comes and goes as it pleases, with a grin far too wide for its face. For eight turns you bite with a grin far too big for any face, trade places with your prey, grow a wood where nothing has a name, stare down kings, leave only your head where a blow lands, fade out tail first, and drive the room mad (Grin of Teeth, No-Name Wood, May Look at a King, No Body to Behead, Slowly Tail First, Which Way?, All Mad Here). Every dodge rakes the one who swung, your hits paint the unpainted, and the first killing blow finds no body to land on. Your size is forgotten. Ends when it fades or you Reappear.

perk.name: Nine Lives
perk.description: The cat comes with a spare.
